description: Revert to the proven aggressive Matrix LR (0.11) and Embedding LR (1.4) with Depth 10 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, as historical data consistently shows this configuration converges faster to a lower loss floor (~0.983) within the 5-minute budget, while the conservative 0.06 LR under-utilizes the time; recent successful runs with this setup confirm it is the optimal baseline for minimizing val_bpb.
